en: Black‑and‑white harbor scene showing boats moored along a quay beside a town. People walk on the cobblestone waterfront next to parked 1950s–1960s style cars. In the background rises a large neo‑Gothic church with a tall spire and rose window, dominating the skyline above older low‑rise buildings and a modernist block on the right. The overall look is of a northern European coastal town captured in mid‑20th century.
